metadata.description: Name of the Log Analytics / Sentinel workspace to deploy the rule into.
GUID for this analytics rule. Keep the default unless deploying a second copy alongside an existing one.

properties.description: Reference/backup template — not required if a rule with this name is already deployed. Compliance control for AFRL-funded project monitoring. Fires when a user on the DoD-Anthropic-Monitoring watchlist is observed accessing an Anthropic-hosted domain (claude.ai, anthropic.com and subdomains) per Microsoft Defender DeviceNetworkEvents telemetry. See AFRL-Anthropic-Compliance.json (companion workbook) and watchlists/DoD-Anthropic-Monitoring.csv for setup. The companion workbook matches SecurityIncident on Title == "AFRL Anthropic Compliance" — keep displayName/alertDisplayNameFormat in sync with RULE_TITLE in scripts/build_afrl_anthropic_workbook.py if either changes.
properties.query:
let ProjectUsers =
    _GetWatchlist('DoD-Anthropic-Monitoring')
    | project
        UserUPN = tolower(trim(' ', column_ifexists('UserUPN', SearchKey))),
        Name    = column_ifexists('Name', ''),
        Project = column_ifexists('Project', ''),
        Status  = column_ifexists('Status', 'Active')
    | where isnotempty(UserUPN) and Status =~ "Active";
union isfuzzy=true
    DeviceNetworkEvents,
    (datatable(Timestamp:datetime, RemoteUrl:string, InitiatingProcessAccountUpn:string, DeviceName:string) [])
| where Timestamp > ago(2h)
| where RemoteUrl has_any (
    "claude.ai",
    "anthropic.com",
    "api.anthropic.com",
    "console.anthropic.com",
    "docs.anthropic.com",
    "support.anthropic.com")
| extend UserUPN = tolower(InitiatingProcessAccountUpn)
| where isnotempty(UserUPN)
| join kind=inner ProjectUsers on UserUPN
| project Timestamp, UserUPN, Name, Project, DeviceName, RemoteUrl

alertDetailsOverride.alertDescriptionFormat: Monitored user {{UserUPN}} ({{Name}}, project {{Project}}) was observed accessing an Anthropic-hosted domain ({{RemoteUrl}}) from device {{DeviceName}}. This is a compliance detection under AFRL-funded project monitoring — see the AFRL-Anthropic-Compliance workbook for full context and disposition guidance.
